title: Transient Joule heating of a strip: quasi-static currents into implicit-Euler heat (analytic)
description:
A 1 mm metal strip (constant sigma_dc, platinum-like) driven by V0 across its ends (electric_currents, quasi-static) heats up from T0 through currents_heat_joule in a time_dependent study (heat transient, implicit Euler, dt 0.1 ms, 20 ms ~ 5 thermal time constants); the ends are held at T0, the long faces are insulated (1D in x).
Analytic: uniform q = sigma V0^2 / L^2 (steady peak rise q L^2 / (8 k) = 40.8 K); the discrete solution is exact per sine mode: theta(x, t) = q x (L - x) / (2 k) - sum over odd n of (4 q L^2 / (k pi^3 n^3)) sin(n pi x / L) r_n^m, r_n = 1 / (1 + dt D (n pi / L)^2) (implicit Euler), D = k / (rho cp), m = t / dt - 1: the first heat step has no Joule source (the first transfer follows it), so the probe sample at t = dt is T0 (n <= 13 terms here).
Probes tab: T_centre with the dashed exact_lagged curve (~1e-4), continuous_time (the exact PDE solution, exp(-D (n pi / L)^2 t), no lag: ~2 % above at t ~ tau_1 = 4 ms) and the steady limit.
Derived values tab: theta_check at t = 4 ms (24.7 K; a one-step lag error is 1.6 %, the continuous-time value 2.3 % off), theta_end at 20 ms, P_joule (integral of q_joule = V0^2 sigma w / L, 1175 W/m); expected ~1e-4 or better (tolerances 1e-3, P_joule 1e-5).
Line profile tab: T_profile along the strip at t_end with its lagged series.

parameters.name: V0
parameters.description: drive voltage in V (x_lo at V0, x_hi at 0 V)

parameters.name: L
parameters.description: strip length along x (cold, held ends)

parameters.name: w
parameters.description: strip width along y (insulated faces: 1D in x)

parameters.name: dx_cell
parameters.description: uniform cell size (200 cells along the strip)

parameters.name: T0
parameters.description: initial, end and reference temperature in K

parameters.name: dt_step
parameters.description: implicit-Euler heat time step in s

parameters.name: t_check
parameters.description: time of the derived value theta_check in s (~tau_1)

parameters.name: tau_1
parameters.description: first-mode time constant in s (4.01 ms)

parameters.name: q_uniform
parameters.description: uniform Joule power density in W/m^3 (2.35e10)

parameters.name: A1
parameters.description: first sine-mode amplitude of the steady rise in K

parameters.name: x_probe
parameters.description: probe x: the cell centre just right of the strip centre

parameters.name: theta_ss_p
parameters.description: steady rise at the probe in K (40.8)

parameters.name: m_check
parameters.description: heat steps with the Joule source by t_check

parameters.name: m_end
parameters.description: heat steps with the Joule source by t_end

parameters.name: theta_check_ref
parameters.expression: theta_ss_p - A1*(s1*r1**m_check + s3*r3**m_check/27 + s5*r5**m_check/125 + s7*r7**m_check/343 + s9*r9**m_check/729 + s11*r11**m_check/1331 + s13*r13**m_check/2197)
parameters.description: analytic probe rise at t_check in K (24.7)

parameters.name: theta_end_ref
parameters.description: analytic probe rise at t_end in K (40.5)

analytic_curves.name: T_profile
analytic_curves.expression: T0 + q_uniform*x*(L - x)/(2*k_th) - A1*(sin(pi*x/L)*r1**m_end + sin(3*pi*x/L)*r3**m_end/27 + sin(5*pi*x/L)*r5**m_end/125 + sin(7*pi*x/L)*r7**m_end/343)
